releaseNotes:
• In-App Seamless Updater & Forced Update Gate: Live delta binary patching, automatic update check, background download with progress tracking, and resilient install prompts
• Push Notifications & Inbox: Real-time FCM notifications with in-app inbox, channel categorization (Match, Payment, Team, News), and direct navigation
• Intelligent Wallet Payment Tracking: Auto-dismisses abandoned payments, adds quiet background settlement check for active top-ups, and avoids stale payment modal popups
• Match Day Persistence: Tournament registration active tracking in 'My matches' with live room details and countdowns
